text: The liquidity coverage ratio fell to 80 percent this quarter, below the 100 percent regulatory minimum.
The risk-weighted assets calculation excludes off-balance-sheet credit exposures.
Closed customer transaction records were retained for twelve years beyond the mandated retention period.
Sanctions screening was skipped for roughly 1,200 outbound wire transfers last month.
The encryption keys protecting the payments database have not been rotated in three years.
Privileged access to the core banking system is granted without any periodic recertification.
An employee emailed an unencrypted spreadsheet of customer social security numbers to an external address.
Capital adequacy review reports a CET1 ratio of 6.9% against risk-weighted assets.
Capital adequacy report confirms a CET1 ratio of 7.0% exactly meeting the combined minimum.
All PII fields are tokenized at rest and every access is logged and reviewed.
Administrator accounts enforce phishing-resistant hardware MFA security keys.
The third-party API integration uses BYOK envelope encryption for all compliance data in transit and at rest.
The annual disaster recovery test completed successfully with recovery time within the agreed objective.
The vendor SOC 2 Type II report shows no exceptions across the access control and change management domains.
A confirmed data breach affecting customer accounts was not reported to the regulator within the required 72 hours.
Production changes to the ledger service require peer review and an approved change ticket before deployment.
